text.en:
Section one hundred and eighteen of Act Numbered Twenty-eight hundred and seventy-four,
known as the Public Land Act, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"Section 118. Conveyances and encumbrances made by persons belonging to the so-called 'Non-Christian
Tribes,' when proper, shall not be invalid as to those who are literate members of such tribes, but shall not be
valid as to those not falling under the class above mentioned, unless duly approved by the Director of the
Bureau of Non-Christian Tribes."1

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved, February 5, 1935.
1 Declared in force by Proclamation No. 768 (1935). See Appendix, p. 402, post.
